fixtures.sourceName: Glasgow 2026 official detailed track cycling results
fixtures.outcomeText: Australia won three titles in the final track-cycling programme.
fixtures.recapText: Leigh Hoffman won the men's kilometre, Alyssa Polites the women's elimination race and Tara Neyland the women's C4-C5 kilometre for Australia. Emma Finucane won the women's keirin for Wales and Matthew Bostock the men's points race for the Isle of Man.
